configuration.knownPriorEvidence: The same map and related budget outcomes already appear in API demonstrations and AI regression tests. This is a configured policy demonstration, not a blind new research forecast or independent map sample.
configuration.attribution: Student selected one higher-budget retry and expressed a small-increment preference. AI operationalizes the offered smaller retry budget as 4 while retaining one retry and cap 10. No exact numeric quote, additional retry permission, outcome prediction or student code authorship is inferred.
configuration.measurementRules: Preserve both attempt outcomes and sum their actual examined nodes. Retain initial-budget success separately. Stop after at most one additional attempt even if the total cap has unused allowance. Do not modify fixed-budget benchmark rows or the original datasets.
